content:
Actually, Quoridor differs from TGE differs on several points:
* no 3 players game
* you can jump above your opponent when you are in neighbouring squares, moving two squares instead of one
* the starting positions are fixed

Thanks for the effort you put into building this.
However, the gameplay is virtually identical to The Great Escape https://www.codingame.com/multiplayer/bot-programming/great-escape

To avoid duplicate gameplay and give your submission the best chance of standing out, it might be better to focus on an original game concept or port a board game that isn't on CodinGame yet.

Damn, I was looking to see if it was already a game but clearly missed that one.

I wonder if converting this to the "Blockade / Cul-de-sac" version is different enough to still be considered. Each player controls 2 pawns and the goal is to reach an exact tile (the opponents starting tile), not just a row. I assume not, since it's still the same just moving two pawns instead of 1.

If not, ehhh, onto the next 🙃

@Konstant
Do you have any thoughts on Harry.B.'s and darkhorse64's comments?

Even with those small variations, it would probably still feel like the same game.

Looking at it from a player's perspective, a brand-new concept is always much more exciting than playing a slight twist on something they already know. Given the choice, most players will simply choose the fresh experience. 

I think inventing your own original game or porting a completely different one has way more potential and bring you a lot more players!

By the way, there is a dedicated channel for game creators on the CG Discord. It's a place to consult your ideas, discuss mechanics, and get feedback from the community before writing any code.
